verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes PagerDuty as a hosted cloud service (trial sign-up with a personalized web address, the 'Operations Cloud'). The locally run MCP server and the installable PagerDuty Agent are client-side integration components, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
